title: Causal Identification from Counterfactual Data: Completeness and Bounding Results
abstract: arXiv:2602.23541v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Previous work establishing completeness results for counterfactual identification has been circumscribed to the setting where the input data belongs to observational or interventional distributions (Layers 1 and 2 of Pearl's Causal Hierarchy), since it was generally presumed impossible to obtain data from counterfactual distributions, which belong to Layer 3. However, recent work (Raghavan & Bareinboim, 2025) has formally characterized a family of counterfactual distributions which can be directly estimated via experimental methods - a notion they call counterfactual realizability. This leaves open the question of what additional counterfactual quantities now become identifiable, given this new access to (some) Layer 3 data. To answer this question, we develop the CTFIDU+ algorithm for identifying counterfactual queries from an arbitrary set of Layer 3 distributions, and prove that it is complete for this task. translated_title: 从反事实数据进行因果识别：完备性与定界结果
translated_abstract: 先前建立反事实识别完备性结果的工作一直局限于输入数据属于观测分布或干预分布的情形（即Pearl因果层级的第1层和第2层），因为人们通常认为无法从属于第3层的反事实分布中获取数据。然而，近期的工作（Raghavan & Bareinboim, 2025）形式化地刻画了一族可以通过实验方法直接估计的反事实分布——他们将其称为“反事实可实现性”。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：在获得了这些（部分）第3层数据的新途径之后，还有哪些额外的反事实量变得可识别。为了回答这个问题，我们开发了CTFIDU+算法，用于从任意一组第3层分布中识别反事实查询，并证明该算法对于这一任务是完备的。在此基础上，我们……
tldr: 本文提出了CTFIDU+算法，首次给出从任意第3层（反事实）分布集合中识别反事实查询的完备算法，拓展了反事实因果识别的适用范围。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the CTFIDU+ algorithm, the first provably complete algorithm for identifying counterfactual queries from arbitrary sets of Layer 3 (counterfactual) distributions, extending the scope of counterfactual causal identification.
